coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, caudal spine +Y, dorsal +Z; bilateral legs X.

concept.reason: Actual museum scan plus primary anatomical descriptions suffice for a bounded genus-level reconstruction; no extra concept images needed.

scope: Complete genus-level living reconstruction: crescent head and cheek spines, eleven thoracic tergites, broad ribbed tail shield with one median caudal spine. PRI76797 is the dorsal body and approximate size anchor; missing extremities and soft parts are explicitly comparative restoration, not a replica of one completely preserved animal.

scientific_limits.en: PRI76797 is identified only to genus. Its approximately 50 mm preserved specimen length excludes rock; the caudal extremity is not clearly resolved in the viewed preview. The added caudal spine, cheek tips and ventral anatomy are genus-informed restoration, not measured PRI structures. Comparative Herefordshire appendages belong to a different, unnamed Dalmanites species, not proof of identical fine anatomy. Complete modeled length is estimated, not museum-measured.
scientific_limits.zh: PRI76797仅鉴定到属，馆方约50毫米为保存标本本体长度，不含岩石，已看预览无法明确尾刺末端。补出的尾刺、颊刺末端与腹肢为同属层级推定，非PRI实测结构。赫里福德郡腹肢属于另一未定种，不证明细节完全一致；模型复原全长为估计，非馆方实测。

scale.uncertainty: 50 mm refers to preserved museum specimen. Adding an approximately12 mm inferred terminal spine yields about62 mm restored length. Other measurements are construction estimates from oblique image and genus diagnosis, not direct metrology.

anatomy: Broad crescent cephalon with raised central glabella and paired prominent schizochroal eyes. A few separated lens facets can convey the eyes, not solid featureless domes.
Paired rear-swept cheek spines, restored conservatively toward thoracic segment7, based on genus diagnosis. Their exact PRI lengths are unknown; do not extend past tail shield.
Eleven free thoracic tergites with raised narrow axis and paired furrowed pleurae. Posterior pleural tips progressively sweep backwards.

Broad subtriangular ribbed pygidium, raised axis with approximately13 shallow rings and9 pleural furrows as a genus-informed simplification, not a PRI counted census. One median broad-based caudal spine extending about12mm beyond plate; no twin fork or radial tail fan.

Slender paired antennae inferred; three postantennal head limb pairs with first smaller than next two, inspired by same-genus preserved material. Do not portray antennae as fossil-preserved in either reference.

Eleven paired biramous thoracic appendages. Inner branches are walking limbs; outer branches restrained oval fans with membrane-connected filament ribs, not spirals or exposed back gills. Fine distal limb joints are conservatively completed.

Six diminishing paired pygidial limbs are an explicitly inferred rendering convention. Published comparator preserves at least three, and its tail is incomplete; do not claim six is measured or that dorsal ring number proves limb count.
Full living animal, low walking clearance. No rock slab, preserved fractures, internal gut display or exaggerated lateral appendages. Color artistic.
restoration_boundaries: Primary PRI76797 actual scan preview supplies dorsal body and scale, not preserved appendages or a demonstrated complete terminal spine.
Budil etal2008 Dalmanites diagnosis supplies cheek-spine and tail-mucro architecture; do not import its Zlichovaspis or Odontochile comparisons.

Siveter etal2021 OUMNH C.29611 is a different incomplete Dalmanites sp. with actual soft parts. Its antennae and distal limb ends are missing. Membrane-linked exopod structure is comparative, not identical species identification.
Shropshire SHCMS:G.02903 D.myops head preview was viewed only to understand eye relief; its61mm head/rock dimensions are NOT whole-animal or PRI scale and must not replace primary anchor.
All missing-extremity lengths, thickness, limb detail, posterior limb count and life colors remain inferred. Original complete-animal gate is retained, not reduced to a shell or fossil fragment.
quality_gates: Crescent head with paired cheek points, eleven thoracic tergites, broad ribbed tail and ONE median spine.
Explicit 50 mm preserved versus approximately62 mm reconstructed length distinction; no rock dimensions.
Separated eye-lens indication and ventral limbs present; no omitted whole-animal scope.
No spiralled gills, no external digestive organs, no long Zlichovaspis-based tail or twin forks.
Four standard views unclipped including caudal and cheek tips; scientific boundary preserved in public description.
